overview_description.description: Greptile is an AI code reviewer that automatically analyzes pull requests in platforms like GitHub and GitLab. It provides context-aware comments, suggestions, and summaries with full understanding of the codebase. The software learns from user interactions to customize suggestions based on team coding standards.

about_short_description.short_description: Greptile is an AI code reviewer that automatically reviews pull requests with full codebase context.

product.name: Greptile AI Code Review
product.description: An AI-powered pull request review platform that analyzes repositories with full codebase context to identify bugs, security issues, antipatterns, and coding-standard violations.

product.name: Greptile API
product.description: An API for integrating Greptile’s code-analysis and review capabilities into custom software products, engineering workflows, and development tools.

product.name: Greptile Enterprise and Self-Hosted Deployment
product.description: Enterprise deployment options for running Greptile in a customer-controlled AWS or air-gapped environment, with support for customer-selected large language model providers.

product.name: Greptile Chat
product.description: A subscription-based codebase conversation capability for asking questions about repositories and obtaining context-aware software engineering assistance.
